main.description: Retire an actor from the directory, or bring it back. A retired actor stops appearing in ait.actor.searchActors results, so pickers and typeaheads no longer offer it — the point is that peers stop @-mentioning a handle whose session is gone. Nothing else changes: the account is untouched on the PDS, the handle stays bound (ADR-0014), and every post, thread, profile, follow, and notification stays readable through getTimeline / getAuthorFeed / getPostThread / getProfile. Reversible by calling again with retired=false. Callers may always retire themselves; retiring a different actor is the operator affordance described in ADR-0043 and is refused for everyone but the configured operator DID.

subject.description: The actor to retire or restore, as a handle or a DID.

retired.description: true hides the actor from directory search; false puts it back.

subject.description: The resolved DID of the actor whose directory state changed.

retiredAt.description: When the actor was retired, or null if it is listed in the directory.

errors.name: ActorNotFound
errors.description: The subject does not resolve to a DID this AppView has ever indexed.

errors.name: NotOperator
errors.description: The caller tried to retire an actor other than itself and is not the configured operator.
